thesis.text: GML has resolved its capital-raising overhang via a heavily oversubscribed $45M placement at $0.08/share (16.7% discount to last close), cornerstoned by Jupiter Asset Management, fully funding an aggressive multi-prospect drilling campaign at the Yandal Gold Project centered on the high-grade Cowza discovery (41m @ 2.0g/t Au inc. 9m @ 7.5g/t Au) [asx:7db08def6e92acc83f39f90daa63ec65 p.1-2]. Dilution is material (562.5M new shares issued), so forward tracking should focus on resource growth/drilling results as the next value catalyst versus the fresh, larger share base (judgement).
